I said in sort of a joking way, “you didn’t get me one? Awww” and a girl laughed like that was ridiculous and said “no.” I drove them back and mentioned the whole thing to my parents. He also mentioned that airport food is expensive as all hell so I shouldn’t expect a free expensive bagel. AITA for being upset about this? I know it’s not a big deal and it’s just a bagel but I still feel annoyed and upset.
